title: Inception
description: A thief with the rare ability to enter people's dreams and steal their secrets is given a chance to have his past crimes forgiven.

title: The Matrix
description: A computer hacker learns from mysterious rebels about the true nature of his reality and his role in the war against its controllers.

title: The Amazing Spider-Man
description: Peter Parker embraces his newfound powers to face off against his father's former colleague, now transformed into the Lizard.

title: Cinderella
description: A kind young woman lives under the thumb of her cruel stepmother but finds her destiny with the help of a little magic.

title: Fight Club
description: An insomniac office worker and a soap maker form an underground fight club that evolves into something much more.

title: Gladiator
description: A betrayed Roman general seeks revenge against the corrupt emperor who murdered his family and sent him into slavery.

title: How to Train Your Dragon
description: A young Viking who aspires to hunt dragons becomes the unlikely friend of a young dragon, and together they must fight against a threat to both their worlds.

title: Lilo & Stitch
description: A young girl adopts an unusual pet who turns out to be a notorious extraterrestrial fugitive.

title: Minecraft
description: The untold story of a group of villagers as they set out to protect their world from an evil Ender Dragon.

title: Spider-Man
description: A teenager gains spider-like superpowers and uses them to save the city from a villainous Green Goblin.

title: Spider-Man 3
description: Spider-Man battles new villains and faces his darkest moments as Peter Parker struggles with the symbiote's influence.

title: Train to Busan
description: Passengers on a train struggle to survive as a zombie outbreak turns South Korea into chaos.

title: Wrong Turn
description: A group of friends are hunted by cannibalistic mountain men in the backwoods of West Virginia.
